source_material.title: KESPA Image Generation V1 — Local ComfyUI/RTX 3070 Integration, Image Bridge, Plan Retention & Scalable Artifact Storage
source_material.status: Implemented / Operational — Phase 2 Quality & Scaling Pending

source_material.description: Current generated KESPA public research manifest through KESPA-NOTE-027, used for deduplication and sequential ID allocation.

directly_recorded_facts: KESPA can detect image-generation requests in normal chat and route them through the existing provider architecture.
A dedicated authenticated OpenAI-compatible Image Bridge mediates between KESPA and local ComfyUI.
Raw ComfyUI is intentionally localhost-only and not directly exposed to the Internet.
The current local image worker uses an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 with 8 GB VRAM and shares the system with other KESPA local AI workloads.
The known-good initial checkpoint uses SDXL Base 1.0 at 1024x1024, 25 steps, CFG 7, dpmpp_2m, karras, batch 1.
Direct ComfyUI generation, local bridge generation, public bridge generation, and real KESPA chat generation were recorded as successful.
A local bridge example was recorded at approximately 13.7 seconds and a public bridge example at approximately 16.6 seconds.

The real KESPA chat test detected the image request, selected image_generation, routed to the local provider, generated on the RTX 3070, stored the artifact, and rendered the image in chat with PASS status.
Temporary raw worker outputs are cleaned after approximately 60 minutes and cleanup runs every 15 minutes.
Generated images retained by the WWW application are stored through the encrypted private artifact lifecycle.
Initial plan retention values are Free 1 hour, Plus 12 hours, Pro 24 hours, Enterprise 168 hours.
The generated-image cleanup worker runs every 10 minutes and uses the normal artifact deletion lifecycle rather than blind filesystem deletion.
The artifact storage framework supports per-user override, plan provider, then local encrypted fallback resolution.
S3-compatible external storage support is implemented but not configured against a production provider at this checkpoint.
External image-generation fallback and higher-quality image models are not configured at this checkpoint.
Deployment QA recorded failures=0 and warnings=1, where the warning was no external providers configured.
The initial retention dry run recorded expired=0, deleted=0, failed=0.

verified: local image generation on the recorded RTX 3070 worker
not_claimed: superiority over external image models or providers

metric_interpretation.latency_examples: The approximately 13.7 s and 16.6 s values are individual observed examples preserved from the source, not benchmark averages or percentiles.
metric_interpretation.qa_warning: The single recorded warning reflects the intentional absence of configured external storage providers and is not represented as a failure.
metric_interpretation.retention_dry_run: The zero counts reflect installation-time dry-run state and do not establish long-term deletion behavior.

publication_exclusions: private user prompts or generated-image contents
repository_identity_rule: The public-research manifest repository field is preserved exactly as the canonical KespaAI-Research repository URL.
